name: Cemex San Rafael del Sur cement plant
products: Cemento CANAL hydraulic cement Type GU

sources.evidence: Cemex Nicaragua's current plant page states that San Rafael del Sur is Nicaragua's only plant with the complete cement production process and that Cemex began operating it in January 2001.

Cemex Nicaragua's March 2026 official update documents major maintenance of the clinker kiln at Planta San Rafael del Sur as a critical cement-production operation and confirms continuing availability of Cemento CANAL.
The current official Type GU product page identifies CANAL hydraulic cement and links it directly to production at San Rafael del Sur.

name: Cemex Puerto Rico Ponce cement plant

sources.evidence: Cemex Puerto Rico's current company page states that it operates one cement plant in Puerto Rico and promotes locally produced Ponce cement.

Cemex Puerto Rico's October 2025 official update states that the Ponce plant produces cement in Puerto Rico and that the EPD covers all cement produced at Ponce in 2024, including GU, masonry and Type IT products.
Cemex Puerto Rico's April 2025 official release confirms the Ponce cement plant was operating and had completed one year without recordable incidents.

Caribbean Cement's current official About Us page states that its main plant is at Rockfort, Kingston; limestone is mined, raw meal manufactured, and clinker and cement are produced there. It lists Ordinary Portland, Composite and Blended cement and states production commenced in 1952.

name: Trinidad Cement Limited Claxton Bay Facility

sources.evidence: Trinidad Cement Limited's official Environmental Objectives, revised 20 March 2025, identify the TCL Claxton Bay Facility, set 2025 emissions targets per tonne of cement produced, and identify Kiln #3 and Kiln #4 ESP stacks, confirming active cement and clinker production operations.

Arawak Cement's current official website identifies Arawak Cement Company Ltd. as an active TCL Group business unit located at Checker Hall, St. Lucy, Barbados and states that it has been producing high-quality product there.

TCL Group's official 2023 annual report identifies Arawak Cement Company Limited at Checker Hall, Barbados and states that its primary activities, effective 15 March 2023, are clinker grinding and cement production.
